text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The group continues to search the tower but still fails to
find any clues to {0}'s lost memories.
text_block_list.orig_text:
塔の探索を続ける一行だが、
いまだ記憶の手がかりとなるものは見つからない。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*...
I knew they wouldn't be easy to find, but these clues sure are elusive.
We should take a short break since we're starting to get a little tired.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ、
簡単に見つかるとは
思ってなかったけどね。
ちょっと疲れたところだし、
ここらでちょいと休憩するかい？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Me too. That said, we don't have any food on us...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
といっても
食料の持ち合わせは……

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! You can't fight on an empty stomach!
I have already prepared our provisions! Please help yourself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お任せクダサイ！　
腹が減っては
戦はできぬ！
ヒョーローの準備は万端デス！　
ささ、
アネゴもどうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Rice balls wrapped in bamboo sheaths, and bamboo canteens, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
竹の皮に包んだ握り飯に、
竹筒の水筒か。

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
There's plum, salmon, and bonito!
And after you're done, I also have steamed buns!
Please eat until your bellies are full!
text_block_list.orig_text:
具はウメ、
シャケ、
オカカデス！
食後には
オマンジューもありマス！
おなかいっぱい
食べてクダサーイ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hahah, you really love Togoku, don't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はは、
アンタ
本当にトーゴク好きなんだね。

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
I do! From \"ohayou\" to \"oyasumi,\" I'm thinking about Togoku
twenty-four seven!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハイ！　
オハヨーから
オヤスミまで
シロクジチュウ、
トーゴクのことを考えてマス！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, looking at your kimono, katana, and
swordsmanship... I take it you were born in Togoku?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば
アネゴの着物、
刀、
剣術……
もしかして
トーゴクの生まれデスか！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wonder.
I've been all over the place, so I don't really remember.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
どうだったかな。
あちこち回ってきたから覚えてないね。

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: A mysterious wandering swordswoman! How admirable!
text_block_list.orig_text:
謎のルローの剣士！　
憧れマース！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, how I wish I could visit Togoku one day.
I must see Mt. Fuji with my own two eyes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁー、
いつかワタシも
トーゴクに行ってみたいデス。
フジの山を
この目で見たいデス！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Fuji is the most sacred mountain in Togoku!
It's depicted in lots of woodblock prints!
text_block_list.orig_text:
フジは
トーゴクイチのレイホー！
ウキヨエにも
たくさん描かれてマス！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
I've only ever seen it in woodblock prints.
But it's my dream to stand at its summit with Shogun and look
down upon the peaceful world once we've conquered the lands!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ワタシも
ウキヨエでしか見たことないですが、
天下統一のアカツキには
ショーグンと共に頂上から
天下泰平の世を
見下ろすのが夢デース！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: O-ohhh... Is that so...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ああ……
そうなのかい……

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
And you cannot miss out on Togoku's food culture!
Whatever the dish, their rice cuisine is delicious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
トーゴクの
オリジナルな食文化も見逃せないデス！
お米の料理は
どれもこれも
デリシャスデース！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
And the king of Togoku meals, sushi, is extraordinary!
The craftmanship shines through so much so that it's edible art!
text_block_list.orig_text:
中でもキングオブトーゴク料理、
お寿司は別格デス！
職人の技が光る、
見た目にも美しい食べるアートデス！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, along with sushi, the repast most representative of Togoku
cuisine is soba noodles! A taste of the common people that's easy on the
wallet!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして
お寿司に並ぶ
トーゴク料理の代表といえば
やはりソバ！
お財布にもやさしい
庶民の味！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
The best part is slurping it up without using manners!
But once I did that with pasta and Monica got so mad...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ズズーッと
音を立ててすするのが
イキってもんデース！
でも前に
パスタを思い切りすすって
モニカさんに怒られました……

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Boss Lady, what kind of Togoku food do you like?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アネゴはトーゴク料理、
何が好きデスか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: U-uhhh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あぁ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this feeling... I know it well.
When she talks about the things she likes, her mouth goes
into overdrive.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
この感じ……
よく知ってるよ。
好きなモノの話になると、
異様に早口になるやつ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Although her interests are different, she's quite a lot like our Nanaka...
text_block_list.orig_text:
好みの対象は違えど、
ウチのナナカと同じだな……

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Boss Lady... Boss Lady?
Is there anyone home?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アネゴ……
アネゴ？　
聞いてマスか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, sorry, I zoned out.
So, what were you saying?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ああ悪い、
ちょっとぼうっとした。
で、
なんの話だい？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Right! I was talking about how you, me, and Shogun will tour Togoku
together, defeating evil in every corner of the country, in an effort to
reform the world!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハイ！　
ショーグンとアネゴ、
そしてワタシで
トーゴクを
ショコクマンユーしながら、
各地の悪を討つ
世直しの旅をするって話デース！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
C-cut that out, will you?!
Don't go dragging me along on your bizarre quest, all right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やめとくれよ！　
アタシをそんな面白珍道中に
巻き込まないでおくれ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! But we have just the right number of people!
Oh! Although in that case, because I'm a female ninja,
I'll be completely exposed every time there's a bathing scene!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー！　
人数も丁度ピッタリデスよ！
ハッ！　
でもでもこの場合
ワタシはクノイチ枠、
毎回入浴シーンのゴカイチョーデース！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: What on earth is going on inside your head? Good grief...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタは何を言ってるんだい、
まったく……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Since Ninon continued her incessant Togoku talk, 
the party found it difficult to progress through the tower.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この後もニノンのトーゴクトークは止まらず、
なかなか出発できないのだった。
